description: Make the backend year-aware and enforce results-only vs predictable at the API contract level. Default season becomes CURRENT_YEAR (2026). Past seasons (< CURRENT_YEAR) are results-only: the /prediction endpoint returns a defined, documented response instead of a prediction. 2026 keeps the prediction feature working and degrades gracefully when there are no predictable (in-progress) series. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: In backend/src/handlers/http.ts, change DEFAULT_SEASON to import/derive from shared's CURRENT_YEAR (import { CURRENT_YEAR } from '@mlb/shared') so 2026 is not a scattered literal. Keep parseSeason behavior (4-digit year or undefined on malformed) but default to CURRENT_YEAR when the param is absent.

Decide and implement the results-only /prediction contract. Recommended: in BracketService.getPrediction (or getPrediction handler) detect results-only seasons via shared's season-status helper and short-circuit WITHOUT calling the predict model or Bedrock. Return a well-defined response the frontend can branch on - e.g. HTTP 200 with a body like { seriesId, season, mode: 'results', message: 'The <season> postseason is complete; final results are shown instead of a prediction.' } OR a 409/422 with a documented message. Choose ONE, keep it typed, and document it in the design/requirements spec (FEAT-004 will capture it). Ensure the existing successful prediction path for the current (predictable) season is unchanged.

Handle the 2026 empty/upcoming and placeholder-team state robustly. aggregateBracket must not crash when teams are absent from TEAMS (placeholder entries like 'AL Higher Seed' / 'Higher Seed League Champion' from statsapi) - verify current behavior and add tolerance if needed (series still aggregate; unknown team ids are allowed). For a predictable season with no in-progress/real series (empty bracket or only scheduled placeholder series), getPrediction for a non-resolvable or not-yet-started series should return a defined 'no prediction available yet / upcoming' response rather than a 500. getBracket for 2026 should return whatever the live API gives (possibly empty series) without throwing; if the live fetch fails and no seed exists, keep the existing rethrow->500 behavior.

Update tests in backend to cover the new logic. In backend/src/service/bracketService.test.ts (and/or a new test file) add cases: (a) getPrediction for a results-only season returns the defined results-only response and does NOT invoke the injected BedrockInvoker or predict path; (b) getPrediction for the current season still returns a normal Prediction (favorite in series, prob in [0.5,0.95]); (c) getBracket/aggregate for a 2026-like payload containing placeholder teams and a mix of Final + scheduled games aggregates without throwing; (d) an empty/upcoming 2026 bracket yields the graceful 'no prediction' response. Mock statsapi via the injectable fetchSchedule and AWS via the BracketStore interface - no live calls.

Update the getPrediction and getBracket handler tests if present (or add handler-level tests) so the HTTP status/shape of the results-only response is asserted. Keep fast-check property tests green (predict invariants unchanged).

Fix TWO pre-existing backend test failures that block a green `npm test` (confirmed present on the base before this task): (A) backend/src/bedrock/narrative.test.ts line ~69 asserts DEFAULT_MODEL_ID === 'anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0', but the code (commit 92c9f36) now correctly returns the cross-region inference profile 'us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0'. Update the test expectation to the current model id (do NOT change the production model id - the orchestrator requires it stays the inference profile). (B) backend/src/mlb/aggregate.property.test.ts is flaky: its arbitrary builds several independent `seriesGamesArb()` entries and flattens them, but two entries can pick the SAME (seriesDescription + unordered team pair), so aggregateBracket merges them into one series and the summed wins exceed the clinch count, failing the `wins <= clinch` invariant (reproducible with seed 1151156412). Fix the GENERATOR so each generated series has a unique (description + unordered team-pair) key (e.g. draw a unique set of (description,pair) combinations, or key the array by that tuple) so distinct generated series never collide in aggregation. Do NOT weaken the invariant assertions and do NOT alter aggregateBracket's grouping behavior - the fix is in the test data generation. Re-run the property test several times to confirm it is stable.
acceptance_criteria: DEFAULT_SEASON resolves to CURRENT_YEAR (2026) sourced from shared, not a hardcoded 2026 literal in backend.
getPrediction for 2024 or 2025 returns the defined results-only response and never calls the Bedrock invoker or produces a numeric prediction.
getPrediction for 2026 with a resolvable in-progress series returns a normal Prediction (favorite is one of the two teams, probability in [0.5,0.95]).
aggregateBracket does not throw on 2026-style payloads with placeholder/unknown teams and mixed game states.
A predictable season with no in-progress series yields a defined graceful response, not a 500.
The two pre-existing backend test failures are fixed: narrative.test.ts asserts the current model id, and aggregate.property.test.ts passes reliably across repeated runs.
`npm run build` exits 0 and `npm test` passes (zero failures) including new backend tests and the fixed property test.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm exit 0.
Run `npm test` and confirm all backend unit + fast-check property tests pass, including the new results-only and 2026 placeholder/empty-state tests.
Read the new tests and confirm the results-only test asserts the BedrockInvoker mock was NOT called and the predictable-season test asserts a real numeric prediction.
findings: DEFAULT_SEASON in backend/src/handlers/http.ts now derives from shared CURRENT_YEAR (2026). getPrediction returns a typed discriminated union PredictionResponse (added to shared/src/types.ts): mode 'results' (results-only seasons, short-circuits BEFORE any store/predict/Bedrock call), mode 'upcoming' (predictable season where the series is unresolvable or status 'scheduled'), mode 'prediction' (normal numeric prediction). All three are HTTP 200 so the frontend branches on mode (FEAT-003/FEAT-004 will consume this). The getPrediction handler no longer throws/404s SeriesNotFoundError; the class stays exported for API compatibility but is no longer thrown by getPrediction. aggregateBracket already tolerated unknown team ids (it never looks them up during aggregation) - verified via a new 2026-style test with placeholder teams (ids 9001-9004) mixed with a real Final game; no tolerance change was needed. Note: a 2026 'Preview' game is still recorded, so a preview-only series aggregates to status 'in_progress' (0-0), not 'scheduled'; the empty-bracket (0 series) and genuinely scheduled (0-game) cases produce the 'upcoming' response. Fixed two pre-existing failures: (A) narrative.test.ts now asserts DEFAULT_MODEL_ID === 'us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0' (production model id unchanged); (B) aggregate.property.test.ts generator now draws a uniqueArray of (description + unordered team-pair) SeriesSpec keys so distinct generated series never collide/merge in aggregateBracket - invariants unchanged, confirmed stable across 5 repeated runs. Added backend/src/handlers/getPrediction.test.ts asserting the results-only HTTP 200 shape (no mocking/live calls needed since results-only short-circuits). npm run build and npm test both exit 0 (shared 14, backend 37, frontend 12, infra 6).
